# Pixova

> Web design, local SEO, and AI marketing automation for UK small businesses. Based in Birmingham. Fully managed, no long contracts.

Pixova builds fast, SEO-ready websites for small businesses across the UK and handles everything after launch — hosting, updates, security, and local SEO. We also set up AI-powered marketing automation so enquiries are followed up automatically.

## Services

- Starter: Website only — 7-page site live in 7 days, £299 setup + £79/month
- Growth: Website + SEO — includes 2 blog posts/month, Google Business Profile, local keyword targeting, £299 setup + £149/month
- Full Service: Website + SEO + Automation — includes lead auto-reply, review requests, CRM, £299 setup + £249/month
